svg.title: How the core AI terms relate
svg.desc: Nested boxes from broadest to narrowest, built from the outside in: artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, foundation models and LLMs, and frontier models. A dashed NLP band cuts across every layer. To the right, agentic AI is a model placed in a loop with tools, and AGI and superintelligence are hypothetical capability levels that no agreed test says either has been reached.
svg.text: How the core AI terms relate

g.text: machines doing tasks that need human-like intelligence
learns patterns from data, not hand-written rules
many-layer networks that learn their own features
creates new text, images, audio, video or code
Agentic AI: a model in a loop
a way of using models, not a new layer
AGI: human-level across most intellectual tasks
Superintelligence: far beyond the best humans
No agreed test says either has been reached.
